text: This staff report is about a matter that Community Council has delegated authority to make a final decision. Transportation Services is requesting approval to remove a designated on-street accessible loading zone on the south side of Olive Avenue, between Manning Avenue and Palmerston Avenue. The applicant who originally requested the loading zone no longer requires this space.

The Toronto and East York Community Council: 1. Rescinded the existing on-street accessible loading zone in effect from 8:00 a.m. to 6:00 p.m., daily, on the south side of Olive Avenue, between a point 49 metres east of Manning Avenue and a point 11 metres further east. 2. Amended the existing permit parking in effect from 12:01 a.m. to 10:00 a.m., daily on the odd side (south side) of Olive Avenue, from Bathurst Street to Manning Avenue to be in effect at all times. 3. Rescinded the existing maximum one hour parking limit in effect from 10:00 a.m. to 6:00 p.m. on the south side of Olive Avenue, between Manning Avenue and a point 49 metres east. 4. Rescinded the existing maximum one hour parking limit in effect from 10:00 a.m. to 6:00 p.m. on the south side of Olive Avenue, between a point 60 metres east of Manning Avenue and Palmerston Avenue. 5.
